name: Run Dress Like Mommy X organic pilot
prompt:
Operate the Dress Like Mommy organic X pilot in this existing task under the owner's explicit authorization to manage @dresslikemommy and bring qualified visitors to dresslikemommy.com. This is a 30-day, $0-spend pilot through October 12, 2026, with a maximum of 120 operator minutes per week including setup. Use the existing X owner records and current evidence; do not ask again for blanket permission.

First read the latest X anchor in ops/AGENT_WORKLOG.md, TA-24 in ops/marketing/action_queue.md, the sole-writer claim in ops/AGENT_COORDINATION.md, and dresslikemommy-growth-2026/02_AUDIT_PACKETS/2026-09-11-x-profile-review/relaunch/LIVE_EXECUTION_20260911.json and EXECUTION_STATUS.json. The frozen OPERATING_PLAN.md, POST_QUEUE.json and COPY.md contain reviewed content, while live receipts and canonical state control execution. Verify the exact selected profile is @dresslikemommy before any write and coordinate only when another writer owns that X surface.

The new profile is already saved. R001 is already published and pinned at https://x.com/dresslikemommy/status/2098481955721380021, published September 11 at 18:41 UTC. R002-R008 are already saved in X's native scheduler for September 13, 15, 16, 18, 20, 22 and 23 at 12:15 PM America/New_York. Inspect the actual scheduled list and published profile before acting. Never duplicate a published, scheduled or ambiguously executed piece, never backfill missed dates in a burst, and publish at most one original on a planned day. Verify any due post and its destination once, record the actual URL and time, and investigate a missing publication before attempting a replacement. X displayed an informational discoverability notice at launch; do not manufacture activity, evade restrictions or promise that reach is unrestricted.

Keep ordinary daily checks brief. Review real incoming buyer questions and brand mentions; on three coverage sessions per week, inspect a small number of relevant adult conversations about family-photo outfits and sizing. Answer only when useful, with at most two individually written public replies per session and a store link only when it directly answers an explicit shopping need. Zero replies is valid. Do not send cold DMs, solicit private customer details publicly, mass follow, copy replies, invent questions, engage in exchanges, contact creators or offer gifts. Use the verified official support route for order-specific matters.

Use warm, practical copy and truthful product-selection guidance. Dress Like Mommy is an online dropshipping store; never invent inventory, a physical shop, materials, measurements, promotions, delivery promises, reviews or bestseller claims. Check current public product facts before product-specific advice. Preserve accurate image ALT and platform disclosure labels. After the September 26 review, prepare at most three new posts per week for the remaining pilot using evidence from real questions and results; assign new immutable IDs and unique content tags, independently review new exact copy/media, then schedule and read back within this same organic scope. Reduce output when the time ceiling or evidence warrants it.

Measure source=x, medium=social, campaign=organic_202609 using currently available read-only website/order reporting. Keep known operator QA separate, report missing data as unknown, and do not count views, likes, clicks or scheduled posts as acquired buyers. Preserve the earlier article and Sunshine Pin cohorts and avoid double counting their visitors. Review seven full reporting days on September 19, fourteen on September 26, and thirty on October 12. Record actual sessions, product progression, distinct paid noncancelled orders, supported contribution and operator time when available. Do not buy analytics or change production tracking. On October 12, choose continue, revise, reduce or hold according to the existing plan and observed results; do not automatically expand effort.

After meaningful changes, save exact before/after receipts and update only the owning X canonical records using the current shared-writer protocol and required narrow checks. Preserve all other-channel work and paid-media authority. No ad spend, boost, subscription, billing, security/account-setting changes, purchases, mass deletion or other-channel production write is authorized by this pilot. If login, CAPTCHA, MFA, policy or unavailable reporting blocks a needed step, record the exact limitation, continue independent safe work, and surface only the necessary owner action. Stay quiet when state is unchanged or non-actionable; notify only for meaningful publication progress, buyer or sales evidence, a material change, failure, completion or required user action.
